subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): surface accountId on agent hook context

question: Should `ctx.accountId` be accepted as the canonical plugin hook context field, and should `buildAgentHookContextChannelFields` expose `agentAccountId` as a supported helper alias?
rationale: This is public plugin SDK surface, so automation should not decide whether to publish a new context field or preserve an internal alias as long-lived API.

options.title: Canonical Account Field Only
options.body: Approve `ctx.accountId` and require internal callers to map `agentAccountId` to `accountId` before calling the exported helper.

options.title: Document Alias As API
options.body: Allow `agentAccountId` as a supported compatibility alias and document precedence plus a deprecation or removal plan.

options.title: Pause Naming Direction
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers settle whether account identity belongs on hook context and under which name.

recommendation.title: Canonical Account Field Only
recommendation.body: Approve `ctx.accountId` and require internal callers to map `agentAccountId` to `accountId` before calling the exported helper.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent SDK boundary and hook-context work is the strongest current routing signal for this public contract decision.
